text: U.S. Orders Chinese Company to Sell Manhattan Building Near Trump Tower Saturday, 11 August 2018 ( 5 hours ago ) The U.S. government has told Chinese conglomerate HNA Group it has to sell its majority stake in a Manhattan skyscraper whose tenants include a police precinct tasked with protecting Trump Tower . ▶ Brookfield Acquires 99-Year Lease Of Kushner's Manhattan Tower 00:44 Brookfield Asset Management said on Friday it acquired a 99 year lease on a Manhattan office tower majority-owned by a company that was previously run by Jared Kushner, son-in-law of U.S. President Donald Trump.
